entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 5719, Standbuch 1012 fol. 445v; citing Recepta 4 Rudolfi f. 191
entries.german: Rosenberg anno 1454 Sambstag vor annuncationis Marie als sich anselm von Rosenberg ritter in Schloss prassoltzheim selbst gehenckt hat, schickte B. [gestrichen: Johan] Gotfride von Limpurg seine gesante zu zentrichter vnd Schopfen, liesse vf ime vnd seine gutter clagen vnd kuntschaft furen, die erkanten zu recht, das B. Gotfriden alle des anselms gutter verfallen waren, vnd wo der leichnam noch vorhanden solt er nit wirdig sein inen oben zum tag herauss zu werffen, sonder vnter der Hausschwellen herauss zuthun vnd zuuerprennen, Recepta 4 Rudolf ifo 191 originale on Sigil ligt in ltra R. Contractum
entries.english: In 1454, on the Saturday before the Annunciation of Mary, Anselm von Rosenberg, Ritter, hanged himself in Schloss Prosselsheim. Gotfried von Limpurg, Bischof, sent his envoys to the Zentgericht and Schöffen, brought a claim against Anselm and his goods, and presented evidence. The court ruled that all Anselm’s goods had fallen to Gotfried von Limpurg, Bischof. If the body was still there, it was not to be thrown out from above, but taken out under the threshold and burned.

facts.content: claimed Anselm von Rosenberg’s goods, which the court ruled had fallen to him.
